ImageObject.description: An image the media server attached (only when the server has images on; see docs/MEDIA.md). Fetch `url` once `status` is `ready` (watch GET /media/index for `hash`); `off` = none will come, show a placeholder.

hash.description: Content key (sha256 hex): cache by it forever.

prompt.description: The full prompt sent to the image model (house style; no engine ids).

url.description: `/media/<hash>.<ext>` once ready, relative to the server's HTTP origin.

Ref.description: A pointer to any row of the world: dg demigod, ch character, cl cluster, gr group, gd god, pl place, it item, ag agent, lg ledger row, ce cell, mb mob. Stable for the whole match.

Visual.description: A character's visual sheet (docs/SHARED_MEDIA_SPEC.md §3.1): picked from the match seed, the character's id and name; the same at every beat and in every replay. Every image of the character carries these traits.

sheet_hash.description: sha256 (hex) of the sheet version, the character's ref and its traits: key art or caches on it.

emblem.description: Their emblem (also on their armies' banners).

description: `game.media`: an image of something in the game, by reference. Through the server: `image` at once (pending, then ready via GET /media/index). The bare plugin (no media server) answers `image_prompt` and `image_kind` instead of `image`.

name.description: The demigod's, person's, place's or army's name; an event's text.

reason.description: Why `image.status` is `off` (images off, a budget reached).

title: game.media

x-args.description: Over HTTP every arg is a query-string parameter (numbers as numeric strings). Unknown args are ignored.

x-description: An image of something in the game, by reference (never a free-text prompt): a portrait of a demigod or person, a place, a public event, or an army. Answers at once with `image` (pending, then ready via GET /media/index); the server writes the prompt from the state. Visibility: a seat may ask for what it can see (public things, its own people, events it knows); over HTTP only public refs. Rate-limited per seat and budgeted.
